in_hebrew.name: Goodwin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Goodwin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English, Goodwin means 'God's friend'. The name gained popularity in England during the Middle Ages. The name is a testament to the belief that a strong relationship with God is essential for a good life.
